audit: The incumbent already exposes 12,288 CTAs per 512-row chunk, enough independent row/head work to fill gfx1151; reducing this launch grid cannot attack 9.418 s of device execution.

A T0 row requires all 256 dimensions to preserve the incumbent 256-thread reduction tree. Grouping four rows consumes the 1,024-thread block limit, preserves the same total wave work, and couples every row at block-wide barriers.
Selected counts vary by row. Safe grouped execution must iterate selected_stride for every row and mask inactive tokens, adding work; divergent early exit around __syncthreads is invalid.
Reducing barriers with wave reductions or combining partial selected-token summaries changes the QK or online-softmax association and is T1/T2, not an exact row tile.
decision: Do not implement an exact row-tiled/persistent candidate. Exact selected-order decomposition is exhausted at this geometry after the 25.2M-CTA three-pass rejection. Re-rank to an independent owner; any future QSA attempt must explicitly enter the production-numerics campaign as T1/T2.
